book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: SAN JUAN Jesucristo yee Añurije Quetire Juan cʉ̃ ca owarique

content: ”Díámacʉ̃ yʉre mʉja ca tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorijere to birora mʉja ca tʉgoeña bayicõa niipere biro ĩigʉ, atere to biro mʉjare yʉ ĩi.
Juu buerica wiijeripʉra mʉjare ãcũ wienerucuma. Niirucu ñucã, no ca boorã mʉjare jĩacõari, “Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca boorore biro tiirã mani tii,” cʉ̃ja ca ĩi tʉgoeñapa cuu.
Atere to biro tiirucuma, yʉre majiti, yʉ Pacʉ cãare majiti, ca biirã niiri.

Atere mʉjare yʉ wede majio, bojoca ñañaro mʉjare cʉ̃ja ca tiiri tabe ca earo, mʉjare yʉ ca wede majio yerijãariquere mʉja ca tʉgoeñapere biro ĩigʉ. Añuri Yeri cʉ̃ ca tiirije ”Ate o biro mʉjare yʉ ca ĩi wederijere jĩcãtopʉre mʉjare yʉ wedetiwʉ, mʉja menara niima ĩigʉ.
Mecʉ̃ra yʉre ca tiicojo cojoricʉ mena niigʉ waagʉ yʉ bii, mʉja pea jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera, “¿Noopʉ mʉ waati?” yʉre mʉja ĩi jãiñati.
Yʉre jãiñaricaro ʉnora, o biro mʉjare yʉ ca ĩi wederijerena mʉja tʉgoeñarique paicoa.

Díámacʉ̃ mʉjare yʉ ĩi: Mʉja peera mʉjare yʉ ca waa weocoaro peera añu. Yʉ ca waatijata, tʉgoeña bayiricaro ca tiigʉ mʉja mena niigʉ dootibocumi. Yʉ ca waacoajata docare, yʉ majuropeera cʉ̃re mʉjare yʉ tiicojo cojorucu.
Cʉ̃ eagʉpʉ, ati yepa macãrãre ĩa majiricarora, cʉ̃ niimi ñañarije ca tiigʉ, cʉ̃ niimi ñañarije ca tiitigʉ, ñucã cʉ̃ niimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ñañaro ca tii ecogʉ, ĩi wede majiorucumi:
Ñiru cʉ̃ niiti ñañarije ca tiigʉ: Yʉre ca tʉo nʉnʉjeetigʉ.
Ñiru cʉ̃ niiti ñañarije ca tiitigʉ: Yʉ, yʉ Pacʉ pʉto ca waagʉ, mʉja pea yʉre mʉja ĩa nemotirucu yua.
Ñiru cʉ̃ niiti Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ ñañaro cʉ̃ ca tiigʉ: Ati yepare ca doti niigʉ Satanás, mee ñañaro cʉ̃ ca tiiricʉpʉ ca niigʉ.
”Paʉ mʉjare yʉ ca ĩirʉgarije nii biiropʉa. Bʉari, mecʉ̃acãra mʉja peera paʉ peti niirore biro mʉjare biibocu.

Añuri Yeri díámacʉ̃ ca ĩigʉ eagʉpʉ, niipetirijere díámacʉ̃ mʉjare wede majiorucumi. Cʉ̃a, cʉ̃ ca tʉgoeñari wãme wedetirucumi. Niipetirije Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre cʉ̃ ca tʉorije wadore wederucumi. To biri ñucã, jiro ca biipe cãare mʉjare wede majiorucumi.
Yʉ yee ca niirijere jee upari mʉjare wede majio niigʉ, yʉre ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉo niigʉ tiirucumi.
Niipetirije yʉ Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca cʉorije yʉ yee nii. To biri, “Añuri Yeri yʉ yeere jee upari mʉjare wede majiorucumi,” mʉjare yʉ ĩijãwʉ.
”Ca yoa waatirora yʉre mʉja ĩa nemotirucu. Biirãpʉa ñucã jiro jañuroacã yʉre mʉja ĩarucu ñucã —jãare ĩi wedewi Jesús.
Mʉja ca tʉgoeñarique pairije ʉjea niirique pee wajoarucu

To biirije Jesús cʉ̃ ca ĩi wederijere tʉorã, jĩcãrã jãa mena macãrã o biro ameri ĩi jãiñawa: —¿Do biro ĩirʉgʉ atere: “Ca yoa waatirora yʉre mʉja ĩa nemotirucu yua, manire ca ĩigʉ nii pacagʉ ñucã, jiro jañuropʉ yʉre mʉja ĩarucu ñucã, yʉ Pacʉ pʉtopʉ waagʉ yʉ ca biiro macã,” manire cʉ̃ ĩiti?
¿Do biro ĩirʉgʉ, “Ca yoa waatirora,” cʉ̃ ĩiti? To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩirijere mani tʉo majiti majuropeecã —ĩiwa.

Jesús pea teere cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca jãiñarʉga niirijere majiri, o biro ĩiwi: —Yʉa, o biro mʉjare yʉ ĩi wedejãwʉ: “Ca yoa waatirora yʉre mʉja ĩa nemotirucu. Biirãpʉa, jiro jañuroacã yʉre mʉja ĩarucu ñucã,” mʉjare yʉ ĩijãwʉ. ¿Atere mʉja ameri jãiña niiti?

Díámacʉ̃ mʉjare yʉ ĩi: Bʉaro tʉgoeñarique pai, oti, mʉja biirucu, ati yepa macãrã pea cʉ̃ja ca ʉjea niicãro. Biiropʉa mʉja ca tʉgoeñarique paimijata cãare, mʉja ca tʉgoeñarique pairijera ʉjea niirique pee mʉjare wajoarucu.

Jĩcõ nomio macʉ̃ cʉtirʉgo, bʉaro peti wijiomo, cõ ca macʉ̃ cʉtiri tabe ca earo. To biro bii pacago, cõ macʉ̃ cʉ̃ ca baʉaro jiropʉra, ca punirijere tʉgoeñatimo yua, jĩcʉ̃ bojocʉ ati yepapʉre cʉ̃ ca baʉarijere ĩa ʉjea niima ĩigo.

Cõre birora mʉja cãa mecʉ̃acãre, ñañaro mʉja bii tʉgoeñarique pai. To biro mʉja ca biimijata cãare, yʉ pea jiro mʉjare yʉ ĩa nemorucu ñucã. To biro yʉ ca biiro ĩarã, mʉja yeripʉ bʉaro mʉja tʉgoeña ʉjea niirucu. Mʉja ca ʉjea niirijere jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera mʉja ca ʉjea nii yerijãaro mʉjare tii majitirucumi.

Tii rʉmʉ ca earopʉra, bʉaro ʉjea niima ĩirã, jĩcã wãme ʉno peera yʉre jãiñarucu, mʉja tiiticãrucu. Díámacʉ̃ mʉjare yʉ ĩi: “Jesús cʉ̃ ca dotiro mena atere yʉ ĩi,” mʉja ca ĩi jãirije cõrorena, yʉ Pacʉ mʉjare tiicojorucumi.
Ména jĩcã wãme ʉno peera, “Jesús cʉ̃ ca dotiro mena atere yʉ ĩi,” mʉja ĩi jãiti. Jãiña. Jãirã mʉja bʉarucu, bʉaro ʉjea niirã mʉja ca niipere biro ĩirã.
Jesús ati yepa maquẽ ñañarijere bii ametʉa nʉcãri majʉ
”Atere ĩi cõoñarique mena wado mʉjare yʉ wederucujãwʉ. Biiropʉa mee ea dooro bii, ĩi cõoñarique mena mʉjare wedericaro maniro, tʉo majiricarora yʉ Pacʉ yee maquẽre mʉjare yʉ ca wede majiopa tabe.
Tii rʉmʉre, “Jesús cʉ̃ ca dotiro mena atere yʉ ĩi,” ĩicãri, yʉ Pacʉre mʉja jãirucu yua. “Yʉ, yʉ Pacʉpʉre mʉjare yʉ jãi bojarucu,” ĩigʉ méé yʉ ĩi,
mee yʉ Pacʉ majuropeera mʉjare maimi. Yʉre mai, ñucã díámacʉ̃ra “Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca tiicojoricʉra niimi,” yʉre ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉorã mʉja ca niiro macã.
Yʉa, yʉ Pacʉ pʉto ca niiricʉ yʉ doowʉ, ati yepapʉre. To biri mecʉ̃ra ñucã yʉ Pacʉ pʉtopʉra tua waagʉ, ati yepa macãrãre waa weo waagʉ yʉ tii —jãare ĩiwi Jesús.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, jãa, cʉ̃ buerã pea o biro cʉ̃re jãa ĩiwʉ: —Mecʉ̃ docare yua, ĩi cõoñaricaro maniro díámacʉ̃ jãare mʉ wede.

Mecʉ̃ra, niipetirijepʉrena mʉ ca majirijere jãa ĩa maji. To biri jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera mʉre jãa ca jãiña bʉa ñaaro mʉ booti. Ate jʉori, “Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto ca dooricʉra niimi,” díámacʉ̃ra mʉre jãa ĩi tʉo nʉnʉjee —jãa ĩiwʉ.
To biro jãa ca ĩiro, Jesús pea o biro jãare ĩi yʉʉwi: —To docare, ¿mecʉ̃pʉ díámacʉ̃ yʉre mʉja tʉoti?

Mee earopʉ bii, mecʉ̃ra nii, mʉja niipetirãpʉra no ca boorora yʉre mʉja ca ũmaa weocoapa tabe. To biro yʉre mʉja ca bii weocãmijata cãare, yʉ jĩcʉ̃ra yʉ tuatirucu, yʉ Pacʉ yʉ menara cʉ̃ ca niicãro macã.

Ate niipetirijere to biro mʉjare yʉ ĩi wede, yʉ mena niima ĩirã, añuro niiriquere mʉja ca bʉa eapere biro ĩigʉ. Ati yepapʉre niirã, ñañaro mʉja tamʉorucu. To biro bii pacarã, tʉgoeña bayicãña. Mee, yʉa ati yepa maquẽ ñañarijere yʉ bii ametʉa nʉcãcãwʉ —jãare ĩi wedewi Jesús.
